description:
RimSort is an open source mod manager for the video game RimWorld. There is support for Linux, Mac, and Windows, built from the ground up to be a reliable, community-managed alternative to RimPy Mod Manager.


Stable release v1.14.1.
The latest commit is 540987ca1c529e5330ca35cf0af6b9da4711fd8c.

Refer to the [action run](https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/actions/runs/35884725284) that created this release.
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 540987ca1c529e5330ca35cf0af6b9da4711fd8c -->

## What's Changed
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
• fix：check AppImage directory writability for update elevation by @Tommy-Hu in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2465
• fix：guard folder-size walk against junction cycles and compute it off the GUI thread (#2450) by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2467
• fix：retry Steam WebAPI update check on dropped chunked responses by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2469
• fix：make just clean succeed when no artifacts exist on Windows by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2471
• fix：prevent startup crash when load-time settings save fails (fixes #2317) by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2473
### Miscellaneous Changes
• docs：fix doc site language bug and sync all ru/zh-cn translations by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2457
• build(deps)：bump codecov/codecov-action from 7.1.0 to 7.1.1 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2459
• build(deps)：bump sqlalchemy from 2.0.53 to 2.0.54 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2460
• build(deps)：bump platformdirs from 4.11.8 to 4.11.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2461
• build(deps-dev)：bump ruff from 0.16.7 to 0.16.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2462
• build(deps)：bump github/codeql-action from 4.38.0 to 4.38.1 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2463
• build(deps)：bump super-linter from 8.6.0 to 8.7.0 in /.github/workflows by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2464
• build(deps)：bump platformdirs from 4.11.10 to 4.11.11 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2466
• test：skip read-only elevation test when running as root by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2468
• docs：correct loadAfter/loadBefore semantics in rule editor docs by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2470
• Add Calculating... locale strings by @LionelColaso in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2474
